shared_elements: incised/carved linear marks on a stone surface
possible schematic figural or sign-like forms
justification: A shows only a few faint, isolated incised lines forming an ambiguous angular shape with no identifiable figures or repeated motifs, whereas B shows a densely organised composition of stacked registers containing elaborate human figures with headdresses and framed blocks of sign-like elements. Beyond both being marks cut into stone, there is no shared motif, no shared relationship between elements, and the manner of depiction (sparse scratched lines versus deep, crowded modelled relief) is wholly different.
